justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtypes for IDs and a proper enum for AccountType and LedgerError, but Account/Transaction internals are plain and there are no further domain distinctions.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningful variants and Display impl; uses saturating_add silently swallowing overflow rather than reporting it as an error, but never panics.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Public surface is reasonable with sensible derives and a Default impl, but there are no doc comments on any public item and no std::error::Error impl for LedgerError.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with derives, HashMap, and clean match arms, but uses manual for-loops instead of iterator chains (sum/any/find) and saturating_add hides numeric errors instead of using ?.
